Eight of ten records have no website. For those, 'operating' generally rests on one or more directory records with address and phone; only Bob Blaine, Iggy's and Mattco had any corroborating reviews. Phone verification is required before outreach.
Barrco's phone is tied to both a North Brunswick and an Iselin address, and R C Stemming's number differs between the batch and a directory - both may be dormant listings.
No contact, quote or booking form was submitted anywhere; form behaviour and CAPTCHA gating were judged by inspection only.
Customer types for the no-website plumbers are inferences from trade category and listing address, not statements by the businesses.
data_gaps: Google Business Profile claim status, categories, hours and photos could not be inspected for any business (Maps blocked).
No verified year-established, employee count or revenue data for the nine non-Mattco businesses; BBB profile pages were not readable.
Next Level Contractors has no phone or address in the batch and no confirmable match in North Brunswick; identity unresolved.
NJ Division of Consumer Affairs licence lookups were not performed, so licence status is unverified for every record except Mattco (licence #12085 published on its own site).
Individual review text was not readable for Iggy's (1.0 from 2 reviews) or Bob Blaine (4.1 from 14); only aggregate scores are known.
